title: TB Nutrition Kit Distribution
summary: The Rotary Club of Bombay Northwest – Malad organised a TB Nutrition Kit Distribution drive at Malvani Colony to support patients undergoing tuberculosis treatment.
description: The Rotary Club of Bombay Northwest – Malad organised a TB Nutrition Kit Distribution drive at Malvani Colony to support patients undergoing tuberculosis treatment. Essential food supplies and protein powder were provided to promote better nutrition, strengthen immunity, and aid recovery. The initiative aimed to improve patients’ health and well-being while spreading care, strength, and hope.
